name: Freddie Gebbett
headline: Ops generalist at a fast-growing AI startup, with a top-of-team sales record behind it. I take the problem nobody owns yet and ship it: a benefits package built from scratch for board sign-off, ops automated end to end, a side venture taken from zero to 10+ paying customers. Looking for a founders / ops associate seat at seed or Series A. More at fwg.fyi.

roles.title: Office & Engagement Manager
roles.siteBlurb: I keep a fast-moving legal-tech team running and the culture sharp: operations, the office, and the day-to-day that lets everyone do their best work.
bullets: Own operations end to end at one of the UK's fastest-growing AI startups — office, vendors, events, internal tooling and the recurring workflows that keep the team shipping — as the person who picks up whatever has no owner yet.

Built the company's employee benefits package from a blank page and took it to the board — private medical, dental, pension, cycle-to-work and nursery — benchmarking the market, negotiating every provider and securing zero platform fees for the first two years.
Learned insurance broking and salary-sacrifice mechanics from scratch to do it; the global benefits lead at a 1,500-person company who pressure-tested the design assumed I had years in the field.
Automated the recurring operational work with AI and n8n so the role runs on systems rather than my calendar, and the freed time goes to the next unowned problem.
Build small internal tools myself when buying one is overkill — an office hub for seating and desk requests, automated office signage — using AI-assisted development.

roles.title: Client Acquisition Manager
bullets: Hired to book meetings; moved into closing within three months — 21% close rate and the highest closed MRR on the team.
Highest meeting volume on the team every month across UK & Ireland — 10–15 booked a week on domestic solar and heat-pump leads.
Stepped across to the commercial arm (TNW Energy) to own a full sales cycle — prospected, booked and closed Custom Solar, one of the UK's largest commercial solar installers.

roles.title: Outreach Associate (SDR)
bullets: First job out of university: 150% of call quota, 133% of meeting quota, MVP award three months running.
Built an email outreach strategy with the MD targeting accountant partners, lifting engagement by 15% — the first time I designed a process rather than ran one.
Set the company record for accountant meetings booked and attended in a month (7 of 8), 113% over quota.

builds.name: Inkly
builds.blurb: One booking link for tattoo artists: clients see the work, book a piece and pay the deposit up front, so the Instagram-DM admin and the no-shows both disappear.
cvBullets: Building one booking link for tattoo artists — a portfolio, booking and deposit-taking flow in one, replacing the Instagram-DM admin that costs artists their evenings and their no-shows.
Designing and building it solo, end to end: product, payments, brand and front end.

builds.name: Annabel AI
builds.blurb: An AI receptionist for dentists — answering calls and booking patients when the front desk was busy or closed. My brother and I ran it together for three months: he owned the engineering, I owned everything that got it into practices.
builds.coda: Loved building it and learned a lot. Turns out AI voice agents are pretty competitive in 2026.

cvBullets: Co-founded and ran a three-month AI voice-receptionist venture for UK dental practices with my brother: he built it, I took it to market — 10+ practices onboarded across three London boroughs, 1,000+ patient calls answered, 100+ appointments booked.
Owned everything outside the code: market research, positioning, brand, website, pricing and all outbound — and learned enough of the stack to hold my own on product calls.
